bundle.shortDescription: NASA Astronomy Picture of the Day as your wallpaper
bundle.longDescription: A tray application that sets NASA's Astronomy Picture of the Day as your desktop wallpaper, once a day. Also supports a random pick from the archive and any specific date since 16 June 1995.
